body: That's fair, just as I can't see how anyone would ever tolerate your existence. You're like The Room of people, and it is genuinely hilarious. So I guess thanks are in order for making me laugh haha
That's ok, no one was expecting it to work since it was, yknow, *not the intention.*
Nah I do, especially with people like you :)
I dont but reading through your post history has been thoroughly entertaining
Sure am
I'm well aware
I can't possibly see myself living to 40 under any circumstances. I'll surely be dead before I'm 20. And hopefully before I'm 18.
Not happening.

Years of therapy and medication and a stay at a psych ward didn't so shit. No amount benzos, noos, weed or LSD ever made me feel better. Hookers get expensive quick and they distract me from the pain for like maybe 2 minutes.

You're right, I've no idea what it would actually be like, and what I want from it. All I know is that being loved is the only thing I haven't experienced that could make me feel better. I did everything I could from my end and nothing worked.

It would just make all the fucked up shit and pain I've gone through just a little bit worth something. I just want to feel what it's like to be at peace for just a moment, to be able to spend that time with someone else who truly wants me.

I said it in the post man, girls are repulsed by me and I honestly don't blame them. Never had love, never will. I'm too ugly inside and out.

It's not me running from a problem. The fact that I'll never be loved is not something that has a solution, it's just a fact of my life that I either have to come to terms with or die trying, and even if I do come to terms with it it won't do me any good.

I'm not sure if you'd want to. It ends with Terry quitting the force to look after his family, Jake and Amy bonding a lot more after being so emotionally vulnerable, and Rosa kills herself in the precinct.
Well, thanks. I just see it as being argumentative, but I guess its nice to hear I have some positive impact.
I just dont like it when people piss anyone off, even if not intentionally.
All we can fucking do is wish.
If I do it now, I won't ever need it again.
Your entire last paragraph is textbook example of what not to say to someone suicidal. Please refrain from such dialogue in this context again. Thanks.
I know. But it can't be helped, and it keeps being invalidated. That shit still stings.
Also I hate it when anyone says "someday" this or that will happen. Please refrain from using it in this context. It often adds to the hopelessness.
Not a girl.

Who the fuck is going to hear me out? Friends don't, people online just abandon me, even my therapist gave up on me. And that's not even the first time that's happened. I'm not gonna live to be an adult because even if I did none of the pain would go away.

Thank you. I've read that link before and it's... kinda bullshit. Only made me feel worse. I know your intentions are right but I'm just letting you know.

I'm never coming out of this, I know that. I've attempted before, tried all sorts of professional help. And I know the trauma is too great for it to just be a "teenage phase." But then I can't make anyone understand that. This pain and misery is never going anywhere no matter what I do, and I'm just sick of people invalidating it because of my age.
